# NumDetect Phone Validation
> Official asynchronous integration for `number_validation_batch`.

## Resources
- Product: https://numdetect.com/products/number_validation_batch
- API documentation: https://numdetect.com/api-docs
- Repository: https://github.com/numdetect/phone-bulk-validation-api
- Registration: https://numdetect.com/register?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=numdetect_phone-bulk-validation-api
- Pricing: https://numdetect.com/pricing
- OpenAPI: openapi.yaml

## Contract
- Base URL: https://numdetect.com; authentication: X-API-Key.
- Submit POST /api/v1/bulk-tasks with service_type=number_validation_batch, country, then file. The response field remains data.product.
- Input: phone, 500–500000 valid entries. One country per task; identifiers must already include the country code.
- Poll GET /api/v1/bulk-tasks/{id} at least 30 seconds apart. Status: processing, success, failed. A successful task may carry result_url; a missing link is a reason to query again, not resubmit.
- Result columns, in order: identifier, activated.
- Processing counters are provisional while preparing=true. Final success/failure counts only appear after success.
- No pricing/reservation quote is returned by the public API. Read current pricing separately.
- Use Idempotency-Key for a retry of the same submission; never blindly resubmit after an uncertain timeout.
- Example input files are format fixtures, not valid production-sized batches.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-30.
